title: 第25章 筑基丹的用处第26章 药草种植的传统
content_zh:
在集市中左晃晃右看看的，看到一家摆满丹药的商铺，叶非凡连忙上去询问。
“师兄，你这卖丹药吗？”
“是的，这位师弟，你看你想买什么？”
听到有人询问，商铺老板立刻来了精神。
“师兄，我想买点辟谷丹，你这有吗？”
“有，你要多少？”听到是买辟谷丹，老板的热情一下就散去了。
“10，额，不，20颗吧。”
叶非凡原本只想买10颗，但是想到自己那果树和药草一年内估计都没得收获，便决定买20颗，起码要坚持到有收获换积分才行。
“行，2颗下品灵石，一手交钱一手交货。”
叶非凡交出去2颗灵石后，便换回一个木盒，里面放着整整20颗辟谷丹。
“这辟谷丹表面这么粗糙，做工连麦丽素都比不上，太敷衍了吧，估计是哪个见习炼丹师的作品，就这做工也能拿出来换灵石，炼丹师还真是赚钱。”
看着表面坑坑洼洼的辟谷丹，叶非凡心里忍不住吐槽。
刚准备拿起一颗试吃下，又停了下来。
“不会有人在炼丹的时候加些奇怪的东西吧，不会吧，炼丹师大佬，你一定要是个正经人啊，千万不能报复社会，不然我做鬼也不会放过你！”
叶非凡最后还是吃了一颗辟谷丹。
吃下辟谷丹后，明显感觉到身体有一股饱腹感，的确是没有饥饿的感觉了，甚至饱腹到就算眼前放着一盆油焖大虾，他也毫无食欲。
确认了辟谷丹的真实性后，叶非凡便离开集市，回到自己的小木屋中，对于贫穷的他来说，在集市中每多待一会，都是对他无尽的折磨。
接下来的日子，就是真的种田修仙生活，每天白天叶非凡都要抽时间去自己负责的田地中观察果树和药草的生长情况，并且根据手册中的要求，对出现异常的的树枝和药草进行修剪，确保果树和药草能够正常生长。
刚开始的几天，叶非凡也在担心李文翰过来找自己搜刮一番，还好李文翰并没有出现，想来要么李文翰还在忌惮王琦，要么就是周彩月是忽悠自己。
但不管是哪个方面，只要叶非凡的固灵佩和微型聚灵阵能够继续使用那就够了。

……
一个月后，正在房中修炼的叶非凡被敲门声惊醒。
打开房门一看，只见一袭青衫的叶飞扬站在门口，青衫的左胸前还绣了一个霄，想来就是灵霄宗正式弟子的制服了。
“这一个月在外门过得怎么样。”
见到开门的叶非凡没有什么伤痕，脸色也不错，叶飞扬放下心来问道。
“大哥，来来，快到房里坐坐，我这一个月挺好的，周围几百米也没几个人，安静的很，很适合修炼。”
见到来人是叶飞扬，叶非凡也是非常高兴，在这里修炼实在是又孤独又枯燥，能够再次见到亲爱的大哥，他都有点泪流满面。
“我在正式弟子那边稍微打听了下，药草种植区域在外门来说的确是很安全的一个了，灵兽养殖或者矿产区域都有比较大受伤的风险。
而像是初级炼丹、阵法、符箓等区域里面，外门弟子都是陪着正式弟子练习，正式弟子大多都是些不好伺候的人，随时都有受伤的风险，甚至偶尔死一两个外门弟子，宗门也不会过问。
唯独这药草种植区域，人少地大，也没有正式弟子过来打扰，而且为了药草能正常生长，这片区域的灵气相比其他外门区域都是浓郁些，很适合现在的你。”
叶飞扬微笑着说着自己从正式弟子那边得到的消息，对于洪长老能把叶非凡安排在这里，他内心充满了感激。
听到这些消息后，叶非凡的心情也舒畅了不少，之前由于不知道其他区域的苦难，因此对于这枯燥的地方他是有些怨言的。
但听到叶飞扬这么一说，叶非凡就能明白自己能加入药草种植区域的好处，俗话说的好，不怕货比货，就怕不识货，与其他区域外门弟子的水深火热相比，这里的确像个天堂，唯独就是天堂里不太热闹。
“那也是洪长老看中大哥，我才能借机会来到药草种植区域，还都得感谢大哥的帮助啊。
content_en:
Looking around in the market, he saw a shop full of elixirs. Ye Feifan quickly went up to ask.
"Senior brother, are you selling elixirs?"
"Yes, junior brother, what do you want to buy?"
Upon hearing someone asking, the shop owner immediately became energetic.
"Senior brother, I want to buy some Bigu Pills. Do you have any?"
"Yes, how much do you want?" When he heard that he was buying Bigu Pill, the boss's enthusiasm dissipated.
"10, uh, no, 20."
Ye Feifan originally only wanted to buy 10 pills, but thinking that his fruit trees and herbs might not be harvested within a year, he decided to buy 20 pills, at least until he could harvest points in exchange for points.
"Okay, two low-grade spiritual stones, pay in one hand and deliver them in the other."
After Ye Feifan handed over the two spirit stones, he exchanged them for a wooden box containing a total of 20 Bigu Pills.
"The surface of this Bigu Pill is so rough, and the workmanship is not even comparable to that of Mai Lisu. It's too perfunctory. It is probably the work of some trainee alchemist. Even with this workmanship, it can be exchanged for spiritual stones. Alchemists really make money."
Looking at the bumpy surface of Bigu Pill, Ye Feifan couldn't help but complain.
Just as I was about to pick one up and try it, I stopped again.
"No one would add some strange things when refining alchemy, no way, alchemist boss, you must be a serious person, and you must not retaliate against society, otherwise I will not let you go even if I am a ghost!"
Ye Feifan finally took a Bigu Pill.
After taking Bigu Pill, he clearly felt a sense of fullness in his body, and indeed he no longer felt hungry. He was even so full that even if there was a pot of braised prawns in oil in front of him, he had no appetite.
After confirming the authenticity of Bigu Pill, Ye Feifan left the market and returned to his cabin. For him, who was poor, staying in the market for a while was endless torture.
The following days are a real life of farming and cultivating immortality. Every day during the day, Ye Feifan takes time to observe the growth of fruit trees and herbs in the fields he is responsible for. According to the requirements in the manual, he prunes abnormal branches and herbs to ensure that the fruit trees and herbs can grow normally.
In the first few days, Ye Feifan was also worried that Li Wenhan would come to search for him. Fortunately, Li Wenhan did not show up. He thought that either Li Wenhan was still afraid of Wang Qi, or Zhou Caiyue was deceiving him.
But no matter which aspect it is, it is enough as long as Ye Feifan's Guling Pendant and Mini Spirit Gathering Array can continue to be used.
…
A month later, Ye Feifan, who was practicing in his room, was awakened by a knock on the door.
When he opened the door, he saw Ye Feiyang standing at the door wearing a green shirt. There was also a Xiao embroidered on the left chest of the green shirt. It must be the uniform of an official disciple of Lingxiao Sect.
"How have you been spending this month at Waimen?"
Seeing that Ye Feifan opened the door without any injuries and his face looked good, Ye Feiyang felt relieved and asked.
"Brother, come on, come and sit in the room. I've been doing well this month. There aren't many people around for hundreds of meters. It's very quiet and it's very suitable for practicing."
Ye Feiyang was also very happy to see that the visitor was Ye Feiyang. Practicing here was really lonely and boring. He was a little tearful when he could see his dear brother again.
"I made some inquiries with the formal disciples and found out that the herb cultivation area is indeed a very safe area for the outer gate. Spiritual beast breeding or mining areas have a greater risk of injury.
In areas such as primary alchemy, formations, talismans, etc., the outer disciples practice with the formal disciples. Most of the formal disciples are difficult to serve and are at risk of injury at any time. Even if one or two outer disciples die occasionally, the sect will not intervene.
Only this herb planting area has few people and a large area, and no formal disciples come to disturb it. In order for the herbs to grow normally, the spiritual energy in this area is richer than in other outer sect areas.These are very suitable for you now. "
Ye Feiyang smiled and talked about the news he had received from his official disciples. He was full of gratitude to Elder Hong for arranging Ye Feifan here.
After hearing the news, Ye Feifan felt a lot better. Before, because he didn't know about the suffering in other areas, he had some complaints about this boring place.
But after hearing what Ye Feiyang said, Ye Feifan understood the benefits of joining the herb cultivation area. As the saying goes, don't be afraid of comparing goods, but be afraid of not knowing the goods. Compared with the dire straits of outer disciples in other areas, this place is indeed like a paradise, but it is not very lively in paradise.
"That's why Elder Hong took a fancy to my eldest brother, so I took the opportunity to come to the herb cultivation area, and I have to thank my eldest brother for his help.
